section_summary.extract_value: This section reports participant information from two samples collected in 2010 (Sample 1) and 2012 (Sample 2) with no overlapping data. After exclusions the final analytic sample was 903 women (1,152 participated; 1,009 completed the BAS). section_summary.extract_value: This section reports participant recruitment across two samples (Sample 1 collected in 2010 and Sample 2 collected in 2012) with no overlap. Of 1,152 women initially participating, 1,009 completed the BAS and, after exclusions, the final analytic sample was 903 women; Sample 1 tended to be older, have higher BMI (M = 27.78) and higher rate of bachelor's degree or higher (83.7%) than Sample 2 (M age = 27.01; M BMI = 25.46; 55.5% bachelor+). Table 1 contains participant characteristics and Table 2 presents the correlation matrix (BAS vs BMI).
